messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary rollout v3.2.1 -> p99 latency spike detected in eu-west-1 canary pool. p95: 140ms -> 260ms, p99: 420ms -> 1.8s, streaming stall rate +12%. Spike started at +00:02:15. Affected route: /v1/chat/stream (model: redwood/gptx-v3.2.1-quant). Link: https://grafana.redwood/services/canary/3845557777 :rotating_light:

alice-nguyen: ack — I'm oncall for infra. Paging @shreya-singh (sre) and @tom-wells (runtime). Can everyone post quick triage findings here.

shreya-singh: looking... grafana shows simultaneous rise in request queue time and stream stalls. tail latency spike is correlated with increased kv-cache eviction rate on canary hosts. dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/rollouts/canary_latency

shreya-singh: quick screenshot: p50/p95/p99 now -> 60ms / 260ms / 1.8s. error budget burn for canary > 4x baseline. No large infra autoscaling events at the same time.

tom-wells: interesting — v3.2.1 introduced a new attention kernel that switches to fallback code path on token types X. That fallback can spike memory access patterns and cause longer KV lookup times esp for streaming with long past sequences. I've seen similar in bench runs but not at canary scale.

carlos-ramirez: any customer visible impact yet? support channel? We should flag customers with active sessions.

support-bot: Customer report: ACME-prod observed 2% of sessions with streaming stalls ~1.5-2s and a few websocket disconnects. Customer impact: intermittent chat delays and 504s for longer regenerations. Ticket #INC-8421.

dave-kuo: can we traffic-shift back to v3.1.9 or reduce canary percentage? If rollback is quick that's safest.

alice-nguyen: agree. Before rollback, trying quick mitigations: 1) disable new kernel flag (hot config) 2) reduce canary to 10% 3) if not improving, rollback. Pushing commands now.

alice-nguyen: run: ```
# reduce canary weight
redwoodctl rollout set-weight --canary-id=canary-eu-west-1 --weight=10
# disable kernel fallback env
redwoodctl config set --model redwood/gptx-v3.2.1-quant enable_new_kernel=false
```

shreya-singh: after reducing weight to 10% we see modest p99 drop to ~900ms but still elevated. KV-cache miss rate still high on canary hosts, eviction spikes persisting. I think config flip didn't clear warmed-in mem patterns.

tom-wells: hmm. I recommend rollback — kernel change requires model serving restart on nodes which is a heavier path and might not stabilize quickly. I'll prepare rollback step. Rollback target: redwood/gptx-v3.1.9-quant.

alice-nguyen: initiating rollback now. Command: ```
redwoodctl rollout rollback --canary-id=canary-eu-west-1 --target-model=redwood/gptx-v3.1.9-quant --timeout=300
```

deploy-bot: ACTION: rollback started for canary-eu-west-1 by alice-nguyen (run id: rb-3845557777-1). Notifying autoscaler to preserve min nodes during transition.

shreya-singh: monitoring logs — streaming session stall rate dropping within 90s after rollback start. KV cache eviction events decreasing.

alice-nguyen: rollback finished — deploy-bot shows success. Confirming metrics: p95 ~70ms, p99 ~180ms now.

deploy-bot: COMPLETE: rollback rb-3845557777-1 finished successfully at 3845558018. Canary pool now serving redwood/gptx-v3.1.9-quant.

shreya-singh: fresh metrics: p95=72ms, p99=185ms, streaming stall delta +1.2% (back to baseline noise). Marking incident as mitigated for live traffic.

carlos-ramirez: good. Any customers to notify? Support: prepare a brief summary for ACME-prod and any other active tenants.

support-bot: Notifying ACME-prod with rollback summary and apology. Ticket updated: INC-8421 -> status: mitigated.

dave-kuo: follow-up checklist: 1) run canary replay tests against v3.2.1 with extended perf harness 2) reproduce KV eviction pattern locally 3) add metric alert for kernel-fallback path % 4) schedule postmortem.

tom-wells: I'll take item 1+2. Likely cause: kernel fallback triggers full-attention fallback for certain token combos causing memory thrash and unexpected KV churn under multiplexed streaming.

alice-nguyen: assigning postmortem owner: @tom-wells. Please include timeline, root cause hypoth, what changed in model release and rollout gating. Postmortem doc in #postmortems within 24h and link back here.

shreya-singh: adding a temporary canary gating rule: require perf-smoke pass (qps=200) and kv-miss < 0.5% for 10m before >20% canary weight. I'll add the rule to the rollout policy.

alice-nguyen: closing live page. If anyone sees regression after re-roll we re-open. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
